commits.subject: fix(health): suppress blend_training and bluesky_post alerts before cutoff
commits.body:
Both alerts had no time-of-day guard, so they fired daily false positives
during the natural pre-cron / pre-post window:

  - blend_training: file blend_<N+1>.pkl is created by 3:06 AM ET cron on
    day N. Alert now suppresses before 4 AM ET (1h cron grace), so it no
    longer pages between midnight and 3:06.

  - bluesky_post: post fires at lineup confirmation (45min before each
    game's first pitch) or via 1 AM safety-net cron next day. Alert now
    suppresses before 22:00 ET, well after the latest typical first
    pitch, so it no longer pages all morning before games begin.

Each check accepts a ``now: datetime | None = None`` parameter (defaults
to ``datetime.now(ZoneInfo("America/New_York"))``) and skips when on the
guarded date and below the hour cutoff. Test coverage added for boundary
hours (3:59, 4:00, 21:59, 22:00) plus the still-fire-when-pkl-present
case to confirm the guard only suppresses, doesn't shadow good signals.
